notes.D7-06: 3-0 verify, and the count is five rather than six because two seats independently found the same methodology hole. grid_fee.max_abs_component is LIVE PRODUCTION CODE: imported aliased at coordinator.py:351 as grid_fee_max_abs_component and called at coordinator.py:6217 from _audit_grid_fee, itself called at :6199 on every planning cycle of a grid-fee install.
